user.title: Connect OpenWA
user.description: Use an OPERATOR API key restricted to the sessions Home Assistant may use (allowedSessions), not the admin key.

webhook.title: Incoming events
webhook.description: OpenWA will POST events to this Home Assistant URL. A test delivery is sent before the entry is created.{error}

data_description.webhook_url: Must be reachable from the OpenWA server. For private addresses the server needs SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS set to exactly this host name.

error.no_sessions: This key cannot see any session. Check allowedSessions or create a session in OpenWA first.
error.webhook_test_failed: OpenWA could not deliver the test event. If Home Assistant runs on a private address, set SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS on the OpenWA server to this host name.

abort.already_configured: This OpenWA server is already configured.

init.title: OpenWA options
init.description: Default chat per session for the notify entity: a phone number (+49 151 …, or 0151 … using the Home Assistant country) or a chat id like 49151…@c.us / …@g.us.

data_description.own_messages: Messages sent from this WhatsApp account arrive as openwa_event with event_type message.sent. 'Notes to myself' only passes messages written into the chat with yourself — a command channel to Home Assistant. 'All own messages' also includes everything Home Assistant sends itself; beware of automation loops.

error.invalid_chat_id: Not a phone number or chat id.

extra_fields.from: From (phone number or chat id, optional; also matches resolved @lid senders)

chat_id.name: Chat
chat_id.description: Phone number (+49 151 …, or 0151 … using the Home Assistant country) or chat id (…@c.us, …@g.us).

quoted_message_id.name: Reply to
quoted_message_id.description: Id of a message to quote.

send_media.name: Send media
send_media.description: Send an image, video, audio file or document by URL or local path.

chat_id.name: Chat
chat_id.description: Phone number (+49 151 …, or 0151 … using the Home Assistant country) or chat id (…@c.us, …@g.us).

url.name: URL
url.description: Public URL OpenWA downloads the file from. Use either URL or path.

path.name: Path
path.description: Local file, must be inside allowlist_external_dirs. Max 18 MB.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Defaults to the file's MIME type.
